channel.title: The Sun Media Corporation - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Sun Media Corporation (thesundaily.my)

item.title: GOF seeks funding for barbed wire at 69 illegal border jetties
item.description: The General Operations Force is seeking extra funds to install high-security barbed wire at 69 demolished illegal jetties along the Malaysia-Thailand border to curb smuggling.

item.title: Boosting national history through education blueprint timely
item.description: National Unity Minister says strengthening history education via the National Education Blueprint is crucial for fostering civic awareness and patriotism among youth.

item.title: Steven Sim hospitalised due to extreme fatigue from work
item.description: Minister Steven Sim admitted to hospital for extreme fatigue, advises rest after hectic schedule but vows to return stronger soon.

item.title: Rain no match for Kelana Jaya’s Ramadan Bazaar on Day One
item.description: Rain on Day 1 of Ramadan couldn’t stop Kelana Jaya residents from flocking to the SS6 bazaar

item.title: Malaysia’s multidimensional poverty index falls to 0.0025 in 2024
item.description: Malaysia's MPI improved to 0.0025 in 2024, driven by gains in health, education and living standards, though a rural-urban gap persists.

item.title: Zakry targets new world-class women’s doubles pair in two years
item.description: New national women's doubles coach Mohd Zakry Abdul Latif aims to bridge the gap to top pair Pearly Tan-M. Thinaah and produce another elite combination within two years.

item.title: GOF seeks demolition of 65 illegal stores on Sungai Golok
item.description: The General Operations Force proposes demolishing 65 illegal stores along Sungai Golok to curb smuggling, following operations that netted RM11.3 million in seizures.

item.title: Microsleep causes 20% of road accidents in Malaysia
item.description: Microsleep, a brief lapse into sleep while driving, contributes to 20% of road accidents in Malaysia, with festive travel increasing risks.

item.title: Bills on AG-prosecutor split and PM term limit tabled Monday
item.description: Two key governance bills, separating the AG and Public Prosecutor and capping the PM's term, were tabled in Parliament for first reading on Monday.

item.title: Deadly California avalanche search to go through weekend
item.description: California avalanche kills 8 on Castle Peak; rescue of 9th delayed by storm. Six skiers survived; search and recovery continue into the weekend
